name: Subscription product metric dictionary
description: Definitions of the measures that the product and billing reports use.

metrics.name: New subscriptions
metrics.definition: The subscriptions that started a first paid term in the month, not counting a restart of a cancelled one.

metrics.name: Cancelled subscriptions
metrics.definition: The subscriptions whose paid term ended in the month without a renewal.

metrics.name: Net new subscriptions
metrics.definition: How many more subscriptions the month added than it lost: new subscriptions less cancelled ones.

metrics.name: Monthly recurring revenue
metrics.definition: The value of all paid subscriptions, each taken as one month of its price, on the last day of the month. One-off fees are left out.
metrics.period: as at the last day of the month

metrics.name: Annual recurring revenue
metrics.definition: Twelve months of the monthly recurring revenue on the same day, to show the yearly size of the paid base.
metrics.period: as at the last day of the month

metrics.name: Logo churn rate
metrics.definition: The share of the paying accounts at the start of the month that cancelled in the month.
metrics.denominator: paying accounts on the first day of the month

metrics.name: Trial conversion rate
metrics.definition: The share of the trials that began in the month that turned into a paid subscription within 30 days of the start.
metrics.period: trials that began in the calendar month, followed for 30 days

metrics.name: MRR (old definition)
metrics.definition: The monthly recurring revenue as it was counted before one-off fees were taken out.
metrics.period: as at the last day of the month
